blurb: Snohomish Flying Service offers FAA approved flight training courses from Sport Pilot to Professional Pilot ratings, including instrument and multi-engine training. They provide on-demand charters, scenic flights, and photo flights in a fleet of 23 aircraft. The school operates year-round with housing available on site for students.
extraNote: School open year round except Thanksgiving and Christmas Day · Flight and ground lessons must be paid in advance or at completion · Veterans must fly 20 hours in 90-day period or go on probation · Harvey Airfield (S43), Snohomish, WA · Year round, except Thanksgiving and Christmas Day
